walkthrough: Identify the situation after release: the hand is no longer in contact, and the question states there is no atmosphere, so there is no air resistance.
Resolve forces into components. Horizontally there is no contact force, no thrust and no drag, so resultant horizontal force $F_x = 0$.
Vertically the stone still has weight due to lunar gravity, $W = mg$ downwards, with $m$ the stone mass and $g$ the lunar gravitational field strength.
Near the surface the height change is tiny compared with the Moon radius, so $g$ is effectively constant and $W$ is therefore constant.
Combine: zero horizontal force with constant vertical force. This is option C.
